briefing.summary: Today's Qualcomm coverage in this section spans FRAND & Licensing (1 article), Patent Litigation (1 article). A total of 2 articles were aggregated from monitored sources.

keyTakeaways.text: FRAND & Licensing: Qualcomm and Transsion not only renewed one of their two existing license agreements through the end of 2031, but also seized the opportunity to consolidate both contracts into one.
Patent Litigation: The two chipmakers have been engaged in a long-running contractual dispute over use of Arm's processor architecture IP.
